characters.summary: Oswald Cobblepot, known as the Penguin, is a Gotham City crime lord who relies primarily on tactical cunning, criminal organization, henchmen, and an array of trick umbrellas containing firearms, blades, and gas dispensers rather than direct physical combat prowess.

techniques: Trick umbrellas featuring hidden machine guns, blades, flame throwers, and acid spray
Commanding armed criminal gangs and assassins

weaknesses: Poor physical combat skills in direct hand-to-hand altercations against skilled martial artists
Arrogance and vanity often lead to tactical oversights
limitations: Physical stamina and strength are limited to those of an ordinary human of his build.

sources.supports: General background, weapons, tactics, and status as a Gotham crime boss.

feats.claim: Successfully ran extensive underground criminal enterprises and weapons smuggling rings in Gotham City.
feats.citation: Various Detective Comics and Batman issues

notableResults.note: Defeated repeatedly by Batman through detective work and direct confrontation.

campaignTags.claim: Uses specialized trick umbrellas containing weapons and tools.

unknowns: Exact inventory of trick umbrellas varies widely by writer and era.

characters.summary: Perpetua is a cosmic Super-Celestial and the creator of the Multiverse, wielding reality-warping energy, matter manipulation, and immense cosmic scale power. She fights using universal-level destruction energies and the total manipulation of spacetime.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to Crisis Energy and specialized multiversal imprisonment mechanisms designed by her peers
limitations: Power can be depleted or contained by specific multiversal locks and Crisis Energy sources.

sources.supports: Origin as creator of the Multiverse, cosmic powers, and role in Justice League.

feats.claim: Created entire multiverses and waged war against the Source Waller and other cosmic entities.

notableResults.note: Initially subjugated Earth and defeated the Justice League before being eventually overthrown.

campaignTags.claim: Perpetua flies under her own cosmic power across space and multiversal realms.

unknowns: Full extent of her abilities outside of the Source Wall context remains vaguely defined.

characters.summary: Patrick 'Eel' O'Brian, known as Plastic Man, is a shapeshifter with absolute control over his cellular structure, allowing him to stretch, compress, and transform his body into any shape or inanimate object. He relies on near-indestructible elasticity and complete immunity to most conventional physical trauma.

techniques: Dynamic shapeshifting into complex machinery or animals

mechanisms: Extreme elasticity absorbing all kinetic impact
Regeneration from being shattered, melted, or torn apart

weaknesses: Extreme cold can freeze and brittle his body, while extreme heat can melt or incapacitate him temporarily
limitations: Relies entirely on mental concentration to maintain complex shapes, though basic resilience remains active reflexively.

sources.supports: Origins, shapeshifting abilities, vulnerabilities to temperature extremes.

feats.claim: Survived for thousands of years at the bottom of the ocean after being shattered into pieces.

notableResults.note: Fought the rogue Martian Manhunter persona Fernus when other heroes fell short due to his resilience against fire.

campaignTags.claim: Can propel himself or form wings/gliders to traverse through the air.
Can grow to giant sizes or shrink as part of his shapeshifting powers.

unknowns: Exact upper limit of mass increase when expanding his body is unspecified.

characters.summary: Dr. Pamela Isley, Poison Ivy, is a botanist turned eco-terrorist who manipulates plant life, secretes powerful pheromones for mind control, and utilizes botanical toxins to dispatch opponents. She fights using animated vines, deadly spores, and botanical subservience.

mechanisms: Immunity to most poisons, toxins, and diseases

weaknesses: Prolonged absence from direct contact with natural sunlight and plant life weakens her physical condition
limitations: Pheromones are ineffective against targets wearing specialized gas masks or non-human entities without hormonal receptors.

sources.supports: Powers involving plant control, pheromones, and weaknesses.

feats.claim: Controlled the entire population of Metropolis using an enhanced synthetic pheromone broadcast through the water supply.

notableResults.note: Frequently apprehended when Batman uses antitoxins or counters her plant constructs.

campaignTags.claim: Secretes pheromones that force humans and other susceptible beings to obey her commands.

unknowns: The precise botanical limits of what size plants she can animate simultaneously.

characters.summary: Kara Zor-L, Power Girl, is a Kryptonian from Earth-2 with abilities identical to Superman, including immense superhuman strength, speed, invulnerability, heat vision, and flight. She fights with direct, aggressive brawling and overwhelming physical force.

mechanisms: Super-healing factor under yellow sun radiation

weaknesses: Vulnerability to kryptonite (specifically from Earth-2 originally, though later integrated with standard variants)
limitations: Powers depend on continuous exposure to yellow sun radiation; prolonged darkness or red sun exposure strips her powers.

sources.supports: Origin as Earth-2 Kryptonian, powers, and combat style.

feats.claim: Lifted and moved tectonic plates and massive structures during crisis events.

notableResults.note: Spirited sparring matches and brief skirmishes ending without a decisive victor.

campaignTags.claim: Possesses innate flight powered by yellow sun absorption.

unknowns: Exact differences in weakness to Earth-1 versus Earth-2 Kryptonite across recons.

characters.summary: Ra's al Ghul, the 'Head of the Demon', is an immortal mastermind and master martial artist who leads the League of Assassins. He fights with centuries of combat experience, exceptional swordsmanship, tactical genius, and access to chemical weapons and global mercenary networks.

techniques: Tactical ambush and deployment of assassin squads

mechanisms: Rejuvenation and virtual immortality via Lazarus Pits

weaknesses: Temporary madness and instability immediately after emerging from a Lazarus Pit
limitations: Body ages normally if too much time passes between Lazarus Pit immersions.

sources.supports: History, Lazarus Pit immortality, combat skills, and League of Assassins leadership.

feats.claim: Lived for centuries, maintaining peak physical condition through regular Lazarus Pit usage.
feats.citation: Batman: Son of the Demon / Detective Comics

notableResults.note: Frequently outmaneuvered or defeated in combat by Batman despite his centuries of experience.

campaignTags.claim: Uses Lazarus Pits to cure fatal wounds and restore youth.

unknowns: Exact age before discovering the first Lazarus Pit.

characters.summary: Rachel Roth, known as Raven, is an empath and half-demon sorceress who harnesses dark dimensional magic, emotional projection, and astral manipulation. She fights by projecting her soul-self as a massive raven of energy to strike enemies, manipulate emotions, and teleport.

techniques: Soul-self projection for ranged strikes and shielding

weaknesses: Vulnerable to emotional instability which can unleash her demonic heritage (Trigon) if she loses control
limitations: Overusing her soul-self or experiencing extreme fear/rage can weaken her grip on her demonic side.

sources.supports: Demonic heritage, soul-self abilities, magic, and empathic powers.

feats.claim: Contained and subdued multiple powerful demonic entities using her soul-self.

notableResults.note: Successfully sealed away her father Trigon with the help of the Teen Titans.

campaignTags.claim: Levitates and flies using her magical soul-self.
Teleports herself and others across vast distances via dimensional portals.
Can transport allies through portals using her magic.
Casts complex mystical incantations and dark magic spells.

unknowns: Full extent of her magic when fully yielding to Trigon's bloodline.

characters.continuity: DC Comics, Future State / Dark Crisis
characters.summary: The Unkindness is a corrupted, apocalyptic entity formed from Raven after absorbing all magic and evil across the universe, granting her godlike reality-erasing power. She fights by effortlessly destroying entire pantheons and consuming all magic.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to profound emotional appeals to her original humanity, which can break the Unkindness corruption
characters.formDifferences: Replaces standard empathic magic with universal-scale magic consumption and reality-erasing dark power.

sources.supports: Mention of dark futures and extreme magical absorptions in alternate timelines.

campaignTags.claim: Floats and flies effortlessly with godlike mystical propulsion.

unknowns: Exact mechanics of how the Unkindness state is triggered outside of apocalyptic futures.

characters.summary: White Raven is Raven's purified, empowered form achieved after fully conquering and cleansing her demonic seed from Trigon. She fights with radiant holy light, heightened telekinetic power, and uncorrupted emotional equilibrium.
weaknesses: Requires immense spiritual harmony to maintain; emotional turmoil can revert her to her standard form
characters.formDifferences: Replaces dark shadowy soul-self and temptation by Trigon with pure white radiant energy and heightened spiritual resilience.

sources.supports: Evolution into White Raven after defeating Trigon's corruption.

campaignTags.claim: Wields purified white magic and spiritual projection.

unknowns: Duration of time she can sustain the White Raven state before returning to normal.

characters.summary: Jason Todd, the Red Hood, is a brutal vigilante and former Robin who utilizes firearms, advanced military tactics, hand-to-hand combat, and tactical blades. He fights with lethal efficiency, combining peak human conditioning with relentless aggression.

mechanisms: Helmet protecting against trauma and gas attacks

weaknesses: Prone to intense rage and impulsive vengeance that clouds tactical judgment
limitations: Relies on standard human physiological limits, physical stamina, and ammunition limits.

sources.supports: Origins as Jason Todd, firearms use, martial arts training, and tactical armor.

feats.claim: Fought evenly in hand-to-hand combat against Batman and Nightwing.
feats.citation: Red Hood and the Outlaws / Batman: Under the Hood

notableResults.note: Defeated by Batman during confrontations regarding his lethal methods.

campaignTags.claim: Uses specialized firearms, flashbangs, and tactical blades.
Wears reinforced tactical combat armor and helmet.

unknowns: Exact effects of Lazarus Pit resurrection on his durability vary across different runs.
